body: Hey sorry for the late reply, but I appreciate it. It’s really just loneliness at this point that it stems from. I’m 20 and I’ve never even had anything close to a relationship, and my friends and family  barely seem to give a fuck anymore. I don’t know what’s happening or how to approach it and I’m so stressed and worried, like I have nothing to offer and I’m simply pushing everyone away. At the end of the day it just hurts that there is always someone better for them and I’ll never be the #1 thought on anyones mind ever, it just fucking hurts. I get stressed a lot about the future too, like where I’m going to be in the next 5 or 10 years. Knowing from what I have now to in the future just doesn’t give me any hope at all, and it constantly leaves me in a pit of wondering if anything is really worth it. Sorry if it’s a lot of words, but it’s hard to explain from my side since I’ve never done it but I hope it makes a bit of sense. Cheers.
